title: Ending story panels are painted but never shown: cut_two_crystals, cut_quiet_mountain, cut_old_dog, cut_president_chair, cut_stone_break, cut_tower_doors, cut_prismatica_top exist in art/gen/ui but no line uses them
repro: grep '"pic"' data/story.json: only cut_campfire/cut_cattopia/cut_chase (+ props/*). The ending beats p5_spire, p5_win (both branches), p5_epilogue, g5_doors_*, g5_win (both branches), g5_epilogue have no pic, so the finale plays as plain text boxes although ART-PROMPTS-20/21 panels for exactly these moments are sliced.
fix: Add "pic" to the first line of each moment (Dialogue keeps it until another pic or "pic": "none"): p5_spire -> cut_prismatica_top; p5_win branch 0 'The dark goes grey...' -> cut_two_crystals; branch 1 first line -> cut_quiet_mountain; p5_epilogue dog line -> cut_old_dog; g5_doors_letter/kept/kept_m/sasha/force first line (or title card) -> cut_tower_doors; g5_win the Dark Crystal 'Take it. The city. The chair.' line or branch 1 -> cut_president_chair; branch 0 'You put the stone on the marble...' -> cut_stone_break; end each with "pic": "none" where the scene moves on. Note for the story owner (outside this scope): cut_rain_road, cut_letter, cut_crystal_prison, cut_merkitty_ring, cut_uphill_stream are also sliced and unused.

title: Epilogue slides run off the bottom of the phone screen: crew, Marked and 'What you chose' have no paging
repro: tools/probe_c7_07_real.gd / probe_c7_07_epi.gd measure body text (font 9, width 234; body label is 300 px tall at y=110, footer at 440): gangster 12 crew = 429 px, 10 Marked = 377 px (507 px in The Chair ending), 8 joined lieutenants = 299 px; a realistic penguin 'What you chose' (3 decisions + fennimore_free, final_town_help, finn_told, knight_reverted, proj_star_beacon, journal_done) = 351 px. Text overlaps the '1 / N tap for more' footer and continues past y=480 off screen. Only villagers are chunked (4 per slide).
fix: In Epilogue.build, split every list slide by measured height (ThemeDB.fallback_font.get_multiline_string_size(..., 234, 9 + Settings.text_bonus if used)) into slides <= ~290 px, titled 'The crew (1/2)' etc.; use the same splitter for villagers instead of the fixed 4. Optionally set _body.clip_text / max height as a guard.

title: Big Jim's tail line shows only in the gangster arc, where the tail never happened; in the penguin arc (where he screamed about tails) he gets no line
repro: companions.json big_jim arc = gangsters, so he is only ever in party.known in the gangster arc; COMP big_jim = 'Big Jim still screams about tails sometimes.' The tail (merkitty scene p4_merkitties, 'Big Jim screams') and the p5_win 'Big Jim screaming about tails' line are penguin-arc only; gangster arc has no merkitty/tail beat.
fix: gen_epilogue: give big_jim a gangster line (muscle/crew flavour, e.g. 'Big Jim still breaks the odd stump for you, and still complains about it.'); move the tail line to flag_lines keyed by a penguin flag (merkitty_done, or campfire_done) so penguin players who met him at the campfire get it. Skip it when the hero is big_jim (run.playable).

title: 'The Chair' ending: the morning epilogue is identical to 'A Tired Man' and has you waking on the farm right after you took the President's chair
repro: g5_win branch 1 ends 'Later, in the chair, you write a letter...'; flag city_taken is set; g5_epilogue (sleep) has no if_flag lines, so both endings get the same rain/deed/Sal-at-the-gate morning with no word about the tower or the ten Marked now working for you.
fix: Add if_flag city_taken / president_freed variants in g5_epilogue (e.g. a city_taken line: a black car at the end of the lane waiting to take you back uptown, Sal: 'Boss. Or should I say Mr President now?'; president_freed: the old man's letter on the table). Keep all-ages.

title: Sal gets two near-duplicate porch lines in the gangster epilogue, and his 'far' villager line contradicts the story ending
repro: Gangster run with Sal recruited and befriended: 'Who stayed' has 'Sal keeps the porch light on.' and the town slide has 'Sal stops drifting. There's a chair on your porch that's Sal's now.' With low hearts the villager line is 'Sal moves on down the road one morning, and leaves a note...' while g5_epilogue just put 'Sal at the front' of the crew at your gate promising to mind the farm.
fix: In Epilogue.build skip the villager 'sal' line when 'sal' is in party.known or the arc is gangsters, and give the gangster arc its own Sal line (crew boss flavour) in gen_epilogue (e.g. a V_GANG override dict).

title: Gangster epilogue still talks crystal money: Ivy 'opens an account in your name with one crystal in it' / 'to the last crystal'
repro: Money.to_cash leaves both Ivy lines unchanged (no number before 'crystal'), so the cash arc shows crystal money in the town slide (probe_c7_07_epi.gd output).
fix: Give Ivy arc variants in gen_epilogue (gangsters: 'one dollar in it' / 'to the last cent') and read them in Epilogue.build, or add the two phrases to Money.PHRASES (money.gd is outside this scope; prefer the generator).

title: Ending and epilogue lines ignore who the hero is: playing as Pip-Pip/Nova or Big Jim you are talked about in the third person
repro: Penguin run as penguin_m or penguin_f: p5_epilogue 'On the fence, two penguins, brother and sister, watching the sun come up' (you are one of them); flag line auk_shard 'Nova still goes looking for him' and COMP_IF knight_reverted 'Nova and Grandfather Auk fish...' when you play Nova. Playing as Big Jim: p5_win 'and Big Jim screaming about tails'. Story lines only filter on if_flag/unless_flag (story.gd ~282); farm's partner scene already has not_hero/only_hero.
fix: Support "not_hero"/"only_hero" on story lines in Story (same as farm partner config) and add hero variants for those lines; in Epilogue.build swap names in flag/companion lines for the playable (e.g. 'You still go looking for him' when playable == penguin_f).

title: 'The blocks' slide lists read badly: no 'and', capital 'The' mid-sentence
repro: All turf and heists: 'The docks, Neon, Uptown, the pit answer to your crew now.' and 'Nobody ever proved who pulled The Cannery Job, The Neon Arcade, The Vault.'
fix: Join lists with an Oxford-style helper ('a, b and c'); lowercase a leading 'The' on heist names inside the sentence ('the Cannery Job').

title: Crew/companion epilogue gaps: Dad and Mom (recruitable in both arcs) have no 'Who stayed' line; Vic's line names Val even if Val never joined; Dice and The Kid 'far' lines are near-identical
repro: COMP has no dad/mom keys; CREW vic close = 'Vic and Val run the gym...' regardless of crew_val; dice far 'still running messages, somewhere, faster than ever' vs the_kid far 'runs messages across the city, faster than anyone'.
fix: Add dad/mom companion lines; give Vic a solo variant used when Val isn't recruited (CREW_IF like COMP_IF); rewrite one of the Dice/Kid far lines.

title: No credits: the 'credits' song plays under the slides but the only credit is 'Made by Tom and his daughter.'
repro: Epilogue last slide 'Thank you for playing ... Made by Tom and his daughter.'; music queues ending_* -> credits -> title. docs/AUDIO-CREDITS.md lists ACE Music tracks and CC0 OpenGameArt packs (all CC0, so attribution is optional), Godot Engine not mentioned.
fix: Add a short 'Credits' slide before 'Thank you for playing' (from gen_epilogue: made by Tom and his daughter; music made with ACE Music; sound effects from CC0 packs on OpenGameArt; built with Godot Engine), so the credits song has credits under it.
needs_tom: Wording of the credits slide (which names to list).

title: Morning toasts draw on top of the ending slideshow, over the slide text
repro: Probe tools/probe_c7_07_play.gd (ARC=gangsters PICK=1, xvfb): after the g5_epilogue morning beat the slideshow opens while 'Falling leaves today · storm tomorrow', 'Next: ...' and 'Thank you for playing. The farm goes on.' toasts are still up; Hud's toast layer is 90, Epilogue is layer 80, so the toasts sit across the middle of 'THE END: The Chair' slide (y ~200-260 of 480), right where body text of longer slides goes. Same in the penguin arc.
fix: In Epilogue._ready add the layer to group "toast_hold" (as game_map boss card does at game_map.gd:1885) so toasts wait until the slideshow closes, or set layer above 90; drop the duplicate 'Thank you for playing' toast from p5/g5_epilogue effects since the last slide says it.

title: The credits song almost never plays: it is queued after the 162-167 s ending song, and closing the slideshow clears it
repro: ending_penguin.ogg 167 s, ending_gangster.ogg 162 s, credits.ogg 176 s. Epilogue._ready plays the ending once and queue_after('credits'); slideshows have 4-15 slides (probe: 4 to 6 in a lean run), tapped through in well under 2 minutes, and _close() calls queue_after('') and switches to the area song, so the credits track is only heard if the player sits on a slide for ~3 minutes.
fix: Either start 'credits' when the last slide ('Credits'/'Thank you for playing') is reached and let it play on after close (play it as the post-ending song instead of area_track, handing back when it ends), or skip queuing it. Pair with the credits slide finding.

title: The end slideshow has no pictures at all: the THE END slide is title + two short lines on a near-black screen
repro: slide0 screenshot (probe, both arcs): 'THE END: The Chair' / 'Hero of Dreamhollow. Day 60.' with ~300 px of empty space; Epilogue builds only Labels. The ending panels (ui/cut_two_crystals, cut_quiet_mountain, cut_old_dog, cut_stone_break, cut_president_chair) exist.
fix: Give slides an optional third field (picture): THE END slide shows the ending's panel (revert cut_two_crystals, shatter cut_quiet_mountain, free cut_stone_break, take cut_president_chair) as a 254x156 TextureRect above the text, moving the body down; 'Thank you for playing' could use cut_old_dog (penguins) / cut_rain_road (gangsters). Keep if Art.has.

title: Penguin finale choice is shown with the Finargle Elder's boss bar and the shards still on screen
repro: Probe (ARC=penguins): arriving on the moon with boss_dark_crystal set plays p5_win; the screenshot at the 'Make the heart / Break the dark' choice still shows 'The Finargle Elder  Mind Fog - guarded' boss bar and her sprite beside the Dark Crystal. p5_win's clear_kind ['finargle_elder','shard'] and boss_fennimore only apply in effects after all lines, so the quiet 'It stops...' scene plays with a live boss bar.
fix: Let a beat clear foes before its lines (e.g. an effects key 'clear_first': true or a 'pre' block handled at the start of Story.play) and use it on p5_win (and g5_win for any adds); or hide the boss bar while a beat with an ending choice plays.
